info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Garnet Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Garnet Drill Details Management API allows businesses to create and manage detailed entries for garnet drill catalog items. This API facilitates the addition of specific attributes and characteristics that define each drill, enabling better organization and accessibility of product information. Typical consumers include inventory managers and suppliers who need to maintain accurate and comprehensive listings of drill specs. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their catalog management processes and enhance operational efficiency.

post.summary: Create a new garnet drill detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry for a garnet drill. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request body to successfully create a new detail.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for a garnet drill operation. It contains all necessary fields required for the operation, adhering to the expected schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details for the garnet drill.

CreateCatalogGarnetDrillDetailRequest.title: Garnet Drill Operation Request Body

garnet_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the garnet drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of garnet drills to be ordered.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the garnet drill.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the garnet drill.

warehouseCodes.description: List of warehouse codes where the garnet drills are stored.
